items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I'll sing Smutty to Boba. While we have some fun up there.

ctx.x: He sang some Smutty songs, didn't he?

Yeah, I know. I will tell you that while he's up there. He's up there. He's singing Smutty and I'll sing Smutty to Boba. While we have some fun up there. I'll tell you that I'll play the fun up there. stuff
But it's always a thing up there.
